payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the source mug to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug present in the source image, moved so it is positioned to the right of the headphones. A newly introduced or duplicated mug on the right does not fulfill the request unless evidence establishes it is the source mug.
outcome.reference: Use the source and edited images to assess the source mug's identity, correspondence, and position relative to the headphones. Consider all plausible correspondence candidates and visual evidence of change in the source mug's region. Do not assume that a mug appearing on the right is the source mug, or that disappearance, blur, or a new mug alone proves movement.

check.question: What are the source and edited positions of the mug and headphones, what plausible edited-object correspondence candidates exist, and what visual evidence supports or limits those correspondences and any apparent movement?
check.complete_when: Record the source positions of the mug and headphones and their edited-image positions, including plausible correspondence candidates for each object. Describe visual evidence linking candidates to the source objects, changes in the source mug's region, relative positions, and any uncertainty. Do not treat uncertain identity alone as proof that no movement occurred.
check.partial_when: Not applicable; this check records support evidence only and does not assess fulfillment.
check.absent_when: Not applicable; this check records support evidence only and does not assess fulfillment.
check.unknown_when: There is no usable visual evidence to assess object identity, correspondence, source or edited positions, or relevant changes.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"In the source, the blue mug is left of the headphones.
